item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02465","case1_error":"Uses Jack's current apples divided by Jack's capacity, rather than Jill's capacity divided by Jack's current apples.","case2_error":"Assigns the brother's lifting capacity to Felix, ignoring their weight relationship and Felix's lifting multiplier.","reason":"The first forms the wrong capacity ratio; the second computes and reports another person's lifting capacity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02466","case1_error":"Multiplies miles directly by dollars per gallon, omitting conversion from miles to gallons.","case2_error":"Calculates one-way fuel correctly; whether the trip must include return travel is unspecified.","reason":"The first has a clear unit-conversion error. The second depends on an ambiguous round-trip assumption that the reference cannot establish.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02467","case1_error":"Subtracts shared movies only once, although each shared movie contributes two excess counts.","case2_error":"Multiplies by eight parties twice, then supplies final numbers unsupported by the displayed formulas.","reason":"Insufficient removal of duplicate counts differs from applying the party multiplier twice; the second also gives unsupported numerical results.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02468","case1_error":"Invents a zero starting inventory and updates cookie counts inconsistently with removals and returns.","case2_error":"Treats the friend's 40% contribution as John's payment instead of calculating John's remaining 60%.","reason":"The first invents and inconsistently tracks inventory; the second assigns the other payer's share to the requested person.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02469","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written calorie sum as 2175 instead of 1975.","case2_error":"Uses the daily deficit, 500, instead of 4000 calories per pound to calculate the deficit required for ten pounds.","reason":"The first is numerical evaluation of a correct expression; the second uses an erroneous relation with the wrong conversion factor.","judgment":"different"}]}
